settlementChain.name: POST /api/payments/{paymentId}/approve
settlementChain.step: bank: payment approval (books the payable, commits clearing.instruction.ready)

settlementChain.name: outbox.dispatch clearing.instruction.ready
settlementChain.step: bank: new trace for the dispatch, linked to the approval span

settlementChain.name: POST simulator submit
settlementChain.step: bank: client span of the signed simulator request

settlementChain.name: POST /internal/operations
settlementChain.step: simulator: server span continues the bank trace

settlementChain.name: callback.dispatch
settlementChain.step: simulator: callback delivery in its own trace, linked to the request

settlementChain.name: POST /api/clearing/callbacks
settlementChain.step: bank: callback request continues the simulator delivery trace

settlementChain.name: clearing.financial_effect
settlementChain.step: bank: after-commit settlement inside the callback trace
